title: The Static (DEPHYRIER)
style: cinematic ambient electronic atmospheric 92bpm pulsing synth bass ethereal vocal layers sparse percussion cosmic static noise signal
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The static is not silence — it's the sound of everything at once
The un-tuned radio between two stations running stunts
White noise is a frequency the brain can almost use
The static lives in gaps between the signals that we choose

[Pre-Chorus]
I've spent time in the static between two things I knew
And the static turned out to be the most productive venue

[Chorus]
The static holds it all — every signal overlaid
Every frequency that ever existed in cascade
The static is not empty, it's overcrowded, dense with code
The static is the universe before the message has been showed
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
The static between stations on a long drive late at night
Is a reminder that the station you were tuned to lost its light
And everything between you and the next clear frequency
Is static that once held a meaning — and may yet be free

[Bridge]
Information theory says the static is the maximum
Of entropy — the noise floor of the whole conundrum
And yet the brain of any listener hears a pattern there
Because the brain is an antenna and the static is its prayer

[Outro]
Static knows everything… and nothing… and everything again…
That's my boy
